candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: Split xizi_dll head (prefix ++ node :: suffix) into the two shift predicates and the four boundary/node link cells, deriving node <> 0 internally.
Stitch xizi_dllseg_shift prefix, rewired predecessor/successor cells, and xizi_dllseg_shift_rev suffix into xizi_dll head (prefix ++ suffix).

premise_discharge.focus_helper: All resources and non-null facts come from unfolding xizi_dll and its dllseg at prefix ++ node :: suffix.
premise_discharge.rebuild_helper: All resources occur in the return VC premise; shift base cases supply boundary equalities.
premise_discharge.singleton_fold: The node.next=node and node.prev=node cells exactly form xizi_dll_links node node node for xizi_dll_empty_rev.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed structural focus and rebuild helpers in the group-local case_lib. For entail_wit_1 select the first disjunct and apply the focus helper. For return_wit_1 select the first disjunct, apply the rebuild helper to the remaining-list resources, and apply xizi_dll_empty_rev to the removed node's self-links. Use direct structural unfolding/induction and avoid forbidden equivalence, reflexivity, transitivity, and sepcon-mono lemmas.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The two obligations are complementary stages of one remove-node ownership transformation and share the same shift predicate/helper family; one group of 2 respects the bounded-witness maximum of 12.
